generation.promptA:
Create image A for a premium cooperative spot-the-difference game.

Theme: 고양이 탐정단의 안개 낀 야간 기차역 수하물 추적. Scene: A whimsical grand animal-city railway platform at night, viewed straight-on from a comfortable medium-wide angle. A friendly vintage steam locomotive waits in the misty background under a glass-and-iron canopy, with warm amber platform lamps and no readable signs. At the lower-left, one friendly orange tabby detective cat in a cream trench coat and navy deerstalker hat examines the platform with a magnifying glass; the hat has exactly one large emerald-green ribbon band. On the upper-left wall, one prominent round brass station clock has plain hands and exactly one large golden wing ornament centered on top. At center, one broad wooden luggage trolley holds exactly four large turquoise suitcases arranged in one clearly separated row. At the upper-right, one large red semaphore signal arm clearly points diagonally up-left. In the lower-right foreground, a friendly gray mouse assistant carries one burgundy ticket-punch case with exactly one large gold five-point star clasp centered on its front. Add a kind owl conductor with a blank cap badge, a sleeping cream puppy on a bench, stacked plain parcels without labels, a brass luggage scale, a potted fern, rails, drifting steam, puddle reflections, and distant train windows only as supporting atmosphere. Keep the emerald hat ribbon, golden clock wing, four turquoise suitcases, red semaphore arm, and gold star case clasp large, unobstructed, spatially separated, and away from the outer 3% safe margin. No readable signs, labels, letters, or numbers..
Art direction: original premium cozy mystery storybook game illustration, clean expressive ink contours, soft cel shading, gently hand-painted paper texture, polished animated-feature background quality, charming rounded animal characters, crisp object silhouettes, cinematic foggy railway atmosphere, cohesive midnight navy, mist teal, warm amber, cream, burgundy, turquoise, emerald green, signal red, and antique gold palette, not imitating any specific artist or franchise.
Do not include text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, borders, split screens, or watermarks.
Keep important objects away from the outer 3% safe margin.
